lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Gym Rat,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: are you busy?
No, what's up?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I've been running this gym for a while now,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and I've noticed that most of our members are adults.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: The reasons for coming to the gym differ significantly across age groups.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Young adults in their 20s are focused more on their physical appearance.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: People in their 30s and 40s realize they're not as young anymore, so they focus on building their stamina.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Meanwhile, those in their 50s and 60s come to do light exercises to maintain their health.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Of course, there are other reasons, such as weight loss or rehabilitation.
Makes sense.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: However,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: we have very few teenage members!
Teenagers are probably too busy having fun to exercise.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Still, the earlier you start exercising, the better.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: If they develop the habit early on, they'll naturally continue to exercise as they grow older.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: What do you think we can do to attract more teenage members?
Let's create an Body X Body mascot and use it for marketing.
Make exercising feel more like a video game.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That's a great idea!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: We can create a muscular character

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: to show kids the allure of physical fitness and make exercise feel more approachable.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: that's a great idea!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I could even take on the role of the villain,

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and every time they finish a set, they would deal significant damage to me.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: They'll only be able to defeat me by completing their full workout.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: That way, it'll feel like a game and make exercising more fun for them!

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Do you think that would get their attention?
Hmm, it could be tricky to pull off.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: You think so?

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: This may be harder than I thought...

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: I need to look into what teenagers are into nowadays

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: and find a way to tie it into exercise somehow.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Anyway, thank you for the suggestion, Gym Rat.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Next time you visit, you'll get an extra hour of personal training on the house!
Haha, thanks.

lines.speaker: rumani
lines.text: Make sure to pump it up today!
